Tile.description:
A KPI container displayed on the page.

Tiles are classified on three axes: `scope` (how many stations), `format`
(size and layout) and `visual` (background of the image). Whether they show
forecasts or a past season comes from the `kind` of their KPIs.

scope.description: `ranking`: every station ranked on one KPI (`station`: planned).
scope.title: Scope

format.description: `full`: the image fills the card; `banner`: image band on top; `compact`: no image, half the height of a banner tile.
format.title: Format

visual.description: Image of a `full` or `banner` tile: `scene` (illustration, option `scene`) or `photo` (photo of the leading station, else the illustration).
visual.title: Visual

webcam.description: Live tiles of format `full` or `banner`: a LIVE badge links the webcam of the leading station while today's period is in progress.

title.description: Defaults to the first KPI's name. A tile of live KPIs must contain `{period}`, replaced by the period label (e.g. 'Neige {period}' -> 'Neige ce soir'); a tile of historical KPIs (Rewind) must not.

periods.description: Periods to show a tile of live KPIs for; defaults to every period of its KPIs.
periods.title: Periods

Tile.title: Tile

TileWebcam.description: When a tile links the live webcam of its leading station (today only).

positions.description: Webcam positions that suit the KPI, by preference (first match wins).
positions.title: Positions

min_probability.description: Probability the leading station needs for the webcam link to show.
min_probability.title: Min Probability
